[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant discussed the pros and cons of posting frequency on Instagram, highlighting increased visibility and engagement for frequent posting, and quality and anticipation for consistent scheduling.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended a middle ground of posting 2-3 times a day with a mix of content types.
